subject: Request: credit for extended latency window impacting production
messages:
From: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@acumenanalytics.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: support@acumenanalytics.com
Date: Thu, 14 May 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Production latency spike — request for remediation and credit

Jonas —

We experienced a sustained latency spike in our EU cluster between 02:10–02:46 UTC this morning that caused 27% error-rate on our mid-tier inference route (model: open-7b-v2) and triggered automated failovers. Our SLO for 99.6% uptime/latency is contractually explicit, and this window meaningfully impacted live traffic and customer SLAs.

Can Redwood confirm root cause, share the incident report, and advise what remediation/credits are available? We’ve attached a short incident summary and request logs. This is high priority for our ops and procurement teams as we approach renewal.

Thanks,
Sophie Turner
Head of Platform Reliability
Acumen Analytics

Attachments: incident_report_20260514.pdf, heartbeat_logs_05014.log.zip

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@acumenanalytics.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 14 May 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Production latency spike — request for remediation and credit

Hi Sophie — thank you for the detailed note and the attachments. I'm really sorry Acumen ran into this; I understand the timing is awful with your renewal approaching.

Quick update from our side: the incident has been triaged by the runtime team as a multi-region routing flapping event caused by an experimental routing rule that incorrectly preferred a lower-capacity Dedicated pool during a transient regional capacity pressure. We've captured all KV cache and batching metrics and will provide a postmortem.

Immediate ask from me: can you share a representative request ID or two from your traces (if you haven't already)? Ben and Marissa — looping you in so we can align on a remediation credit. Per playbook, credits above $10k need managerial sign-off and anything above $40k requires exec approval.

I'll keep you posted with the postmortem and a proposed remediation package within 48 hours.

— Jonas
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed concession for Acumen — requesting approval path

Jonas / Ben —

Reviewing the impact and ARR for Acumen (annual commitment $540k). Based on the incident window and estimated lost throughput, my recommended remediation package is:
- One-time custom credit equivalent to one month of committed consumption (~$45,000) applied to the June invoice, OR
- If they prefer a percentage, a 20% credit on the affected month (May) capped at $50k.

This is above my approval limit. Per policy: >$25k requires LA approval (Laura), and >$40k needs head-of-sales sign-off or finance concurrence. We should also offer 1 month of prioritized SRE support for distro tuning free of charge.

Attachments: draft_credit_note_acumen_v1.docx (internal)

Marissa
Sales Ops Lead

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: finance-ops@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed concession for Acumen — requesting approval path

Team —

Thank you for the thorough analysis. Given Acumen's strategic value (renewal in Q3, references for our analytics vertical) and the clear operational fault on our side, I approve the following one-time concession:

- Approve custom credit equal to one month of committed spend (~$45,000) to be issued as a statement credit applied to June invoice.
- Additionally, offer one month of prioritized SRE support (no charge).

Conditions:
- Credit is a one-time goodwill concession only; it does not change SLA terms or future liability.
- We will deliver a consolidated postmortem and corrective action plan by 2026-05-21.

Finance: please prepare the credit memo and ensure the cap is exactly $45,000; route through standard billing workflows and mark as "SLA goodwill credit — exec approved".

— Laura Bennett
VP, Commercial Operations

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@acumenanalytics.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, finance-ops@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Production latency spike — request for remediation and credit

Sophie —

Thanks again for your patience while we investigated. Per our internal review and exec sign-off, Redwood will issue a one-time credit equal to one month of your committed spend (~$45,000) to be applied to your June invoice. Finance will prepare the memo and you should see the credit applied in the next billing cycle.

We will also provide the full postmortem and the corrective action plan by Friday (2026-05-21), and we’re standing up a prioritized SRE engagement for one month to help tune your routing policies and batching profile.

If this works for Acumen, I can route the credit memo and final postmortem to your procurement contact and get the support kickoff scheduled this week.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198
